subject: Quick check: stalled AtlasAI pilot — next steps & who owns remediation
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Heather Lin <heather.lin@atlasai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-12T09:18:00-08:00
Subject: AtlasAI pilot kickoff — recap + low-friction next steps

Hi Heather — great to meet you earlier. Quick recap from today’s call and proposed next steps so we don’t lose momentum:

- Goal: Evaluate inference cost and latency for AtlasAI’s ingest pipeline (50–100 reqs/sec peak).
- Success criteria: <10% tail latency at 99th pctile, embedding throughput for batch re-ingest within 3 hours
- Current blocker: Security team wants a short SOC2 artifact and an explanation of data retention before provisioning private trial cluster.

Can you confirm who on your side will be shepherding security/infosec? I’m happy to do a brief 20-min intro w/ Connor (our SE) to walk the artifacts and deployment options.

Attached is a one-page onboarding playbook and a SOC2 evidence summary that Connor can reference. If we can get a date for a security touchpoint this week, we can unblock the pilot provisioning.

Proposed: 20-min call Thurs 12/15 10:00–10:20 PT — does that work?

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Martinez
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0192

Hi Alex — thanks for the recap. Quick note: I forwarded the SOC2 summary to our security lead (Marta) but she’s on a compliance audit through next week.

I’m copying Tom (product) and security; Tom will coordinate scheduling. We may not be able to meet before 12/21. Is there anything the team can pre-provide in the meantime (short diagram of data paths, retention TTLs, redaction guidance)?

—Heather

Date: 2026-12-18T09:04:00-08:00
Subject: quick escalation — offer to run security Q&A with Marta asynchronously

Heather — looping Marissa for visibility. We haven’t seen availability come through for a call. Two low-effort options to keep the pilot moving: 

1) Connor and I can record a ~12-minute walkthrough that summarizes data flow, retention settings, and encryption at rest/in transit. We’ll upload to a private Drive link for Marta to view on her schedule.
2) If Marta prefers a checklist-first approach, we’ll fill in a one-page security mapping against AtlasAI’s security questionnaire (I can have that back within 24 hours).

If neither is ideal, please let us know who on your side we should coordinate with (Marta’s backup or procurement). If we don’t hear back, I’ll assume security is not blocking and we’ll provision a sandbox for a short smoke test (with strict retention TTL) on 12/22. I want to avoid surprising you — calling out the fallback so scheduling decisions are clear.

Thanks,
Alex

Alex — thanks for the patience and for outlining options. We had an internal shift: Marta’s audit pushed out but procurement has prioritized an initial sandbox to run actual ingest tests (they need evidence of functional behavior vs. a diagram).

Can you do the following by EOD 12/21?
- Provision a sandbox cluster (non-prod) with 30-day retention TTL and RBAC so we can run ingest and measure latency.
- Provide the SOC2 evidence summary you mentioned and a short config guide for the sandbox (what env vars to set, network ports).

We’ll sign a short sandbox addendum if needed — I’ll have procurement reach out. If you need a quick call to confirm parameters, Connor and I can do 20 mins tomorrow morning 12/21 9:00–9:20 PT.

Tom O'Neill
Senior Product Manager, AtlasAI
tom.oneill@atlasai.com
